Preserve mature feminine attractiveness, confident graceful star presence, sophisticated slender upright body, poised raised hand near shoulder as original and other hand relaxed. Genuine beautiful fox face, NOT a human woman's face with ears. Reference 2 Dragon Queen closeup is ONLY for high-end CGI fidelity, individually resolved fine hair/fur, soft warm key and subtle cool fill, textile thread relief and distinct pearl/stone/metal response. NEVER borrow dragon muzzle, scales, horns, jade colors, dragon identity or crown.
Match original wardrobe exactly: champagne ivory silk long gown with raised gold peony/floral embroidery, lavender outer wide sleeves and cape with fine gold borders, pale purple layered underskirt, dark gold embroidered waist sash, oval lavender gemstone waist clasp and matching pendant, softly lustrous pearl shoulder swags and hanging bead/tassel ornaments, original long golden fingernails, delicate ivory furred fox feet with neat gold claws at hem. Keep original arrangement rather than inventing extra tails to fill space, no tails from shoulders. Tails remain clear of neighboring figures. Match side and back bun and pearl chains faithfully. IMPORTANT existing project ring rule: replace the oversized diamond in drawing with a SMALL delicate clear diamond ring on the raised hand, stone width no greater than that finger's width, visible facets and fine gold setting, NOT a huge stone, not absent.
High-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved fine ivory fur and hair strands with layered natural flow, fine silk weave and weight, distinctly raised gold-thread embroidery, carved gold filigree with brushed roughness, translucent lavender gems, soft lustrous pearls, tiny brilliant diamond. No flat gold paint, no plastic figurine, no cel shading, no drawn outlines, no paper grain, no smearing, no blown-out white fur, no excessive bloom or depth of field. All three whole figures sharp with crisp natural detail. Preserve reference composition and identity while rebuilding rendering. No microphone, stage equipment, royal dragon accessories or additional people. Highest native detail.
